<span><b>Status:</b> Ongoing</span>										<span><b>Studio:</b> <a href="https://anoboy.be/studio/east-fish-studio/" rel="tag">East Fish Studio</a></span>					<span class="split"><b>Released:</b> 2026</span>										<span><b>Season:</b> <a href="https://anoboy.be/season/fall-2026/" rel="tag">Fall 2026</a></span>										<span><b>Type:</b> TV</span>																				<span class="split"><b>Director:</b> <a href="https://anoboy.be/director/hoshino-misuzu/" rel="tag">Hoshino Misuzu</a></span>					<span class="split"><b>Casts:</b> <a href="https://anoboy.be/cast/fukushima-haruna/" rel="tag">Fukushima Haruna</a>, <a href="https://anoboy.be/cast/hieda-nene/" rel="tag">Hieda Nene</a>, <a href="https://anoboy.be/cast/iwata-haruki/" rel="tag">Iwata Haruki</a>, <a href="https://anoboy.be/cast/mikami-shiori/" rel="tag">Mikami Shiori</a>, <a href="https://anoboy.be/cast/saeki-iori/" rel="tag">Saeki Iori</a>, <a href="https://anoboy.be/cast/segawa-misa/" rel="tag">Segawa Misa</a>, <a href="https://anoboy.be/cast/shouji-mao/" rel="tag">Shouji Mao</a>, <a href="https://anoboy.be/cast/tachibana-may/" rel="tag">Tachibana May</a>, <a href="https://anoboy.be/cast/takahashi-minami/" rel="tag">Takahashi Minami</a>, <a href="https://anoboy.be/cast/tsukishiro-hika/" rel="tag">Tsukishiro Hika</a></span></div><div class="genxed"><a href="https://anoboy.be/genres/adult-cast/" rel="tag">Adult Cast</a> <a href="https://anoboy.be/genres/cgdct/" rel="tag">CGDCT</a> <a href="https://anoboy.be/genres/slice-of-life/" rel="tag">Slice of Life</a></div><div class="desc mindes">
Misaki, a university student, feeling the weight of everyday life and uncertain about her future, she longs for adventure and something she can be truly passionate about.At the start of the new day on campus, members of the Travel Train Club (commonly known as the Tetsuryo Club) invite Misaki to join them, as she steps into the world of railways, Misaki&#039;s heart beats with excitement for the journey that awaits her.(Source: MAL News)						<span class="colap"></span></div></div></div></div><div class="bixbox"><div class="releases"><h3><span>Recommended Series</span></h3></div><div class="listupd"><article class="bs" itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="http://schema.org/CreativeWork"><div class="bsx">
